# hexdump

Published version: `cli/hexdump@0.1.5`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Display binary data for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/hexdump@0.1.5 [OPTION]... [FILE]...
```

## Supported scope

Concatenate files or stdin and display numeric/character formats. Supports custom formats, byte limits, skips and explicit color rules.

## Extension and diagnostic contract

Project extension: forward -s/--skip on stdin discards bytes without seeking.
The util-linux 2.40 pipe-input seek rejection is not claimed compatible.

See [the finite option and diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics) for the scope and upstream distinction.

## Limitations

- Numeric words use little-endian byte order. Locale-aware character rendering is unsupported.
- Automatic terminal color is unavailable; auto remains uncolored. Custom %% conversions are rejected.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/hexdump@0.1.5 -C data.bin
moonx cli/hexdump@0.1.5 -s16 -n32 -v data.bin
```
